title: Medical decision support system using weakly-labeled lung CT scans.
summary: The full paper evaluates weakly labeled DenseNet classification and lesion analysis on public sets and 1,322 multi-institutional CT studies labeled by clinical tests. On the held-out study set it reports 0.86 accuracy for abnormal-versus-COVID classification and 0.82 for normal-versus-abnormal. This is retrospective diagnostic validation, not evidence of patient benefit. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
